title: Wheel momentum: dumping before saturation
summary: Small disturbance torques have been filling the reaction wheels for days and automatic dumping is off.
goals: Understand why reaction wheels fill up
Read wheel speed and momentum telemetry
situation: A software patch disabled automatic momentum dumping. The wheels now store a lot of momentum; if one saturates the satellite loses pointing.

steps.text: Check the stored momentum in the Attitude group (above 70%).
steps.hint: 'Stored (net) momentum' and the wheel speeds in rpm.

steps.text: Start momentum dumping: ADCS DUMP NOW (or DUMP ON).
steps.hint: Magnetorquers create a torque against Earth's field that slowly unloads the wheels.
Dumping only works across the magnetic field - it can take a while. Use time warp.

successText: Wheels unloaded. On satellites without magnetorquers (MEO, GEO) thrusters do this job and use propellant.
